about: The 16 groups of the Notes tab and the rules that place every note in exactly one of them (docs/NOTES-PAGE-PLAN.md, section B, approved by the owner on 9 Oct 2026). Read by src/catalogue/noteGroups.ts. A review changes this file or data/note-group-overrides.json, never the code. Rules run in order: a reviewed override, an alias (data/note-aliases.json, then the icon manifest), an exact phrase, a named molecule, the head noun (the last word once suffixes and origins are stripped; for X de Y or X of Y the first part), else More Notes. A keyword anywhere else in a name is only a suggestion for review (npm run notes:groups), never applied.
author: Own words for PriceSniffs (Claude Opus 5.5, from the owner approved list of 9 Oct 2026)
sources: The group list, names and order: the owner, 9 Oct 2026.
Head words: general perfumery and botanical vocabulary common to textbooks and trade use, written down from our own knowledge for this file.
Molecule names: the published trade names of aroma materials, placed by decision 6 of the plan (musk and amber molecules in Musk and Amber, other molecules in Modern Accords and Aldehydes).
Our own data: the head noun of each note name in our catalogue.
Nothing was taken from any fragrance database site (docs/DECISIONS.md D26).
